dominant_strengths: Showcase grid effectively flexes Framer's range with bold, varied typographic specimens across cards
Top nav is restrained and legible, letting the colorful project tiles carry visual weight without competing
Logo wall at bottom adds credibility through clean monochrome treatment and balanced spacing
dominant_weaknesses: Card palette collisions—neon yellow, cobalt blue, orange, and muted olive—create chromatic noise without a unifying tonal system
Mosaic grid has uneven vertical rhythm with awkward card heights, producing visible gaps and misaligned baselines between columns
Reflective layer is thin: nothing communicates Framer's product story beyond 'look at these sites,' so meaning hinges entirely on thumbnails
fix_priorities: Introduce subtle dividers or consistent card aspect ratios to fix the broken masonry rhythm
Add a tonal scrim or curated palette grouping so adjacent tiles harmonize rather than clash
Layer in a short headline or framing copy near the hero to anchor the gallery with narrative intent
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral punch from saturated tiles outweighs behavioral clarity, while reflective payoff stays shallow without product narrative.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes—it functions as a Framer showcase scroll, demonstrating template diversity, though the curation feels more chaotic than intentional.
